description: Magnetic hysteresis loops (M-H) of seven anisotropic SmFe10V2 bulks pressed at 0.4-4.0 GPa (seven coloured lines, legend inside at the top left), internal field -24.5..24.5 kOe, magnetization -95..95 emu/g: a true four-quadrant chart in a closed Origin box frame with black zero lines through the origin. Inward major ticks every 5 kOe / 20 emu/g and minor ticks halfway, mirrored on the top and right frame lines. Journal figure (Zhou et al. 2024, Nanomaterials 14:1329, Fig. 6 panel a; crop x 0-1835, y 0-1458 of the publisher's 3832x1458 PNG), 1835x1458 PNG. The source is pixel-doubled (rows and columns repeat in pairs), so edges move in 2 px steps. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line (black, ~5 px), which carries the ticks; the black zero line (row 646.91, ~4 px) through the middle carries none. Inward majors (~14 px) at -20..20 every 5 kOe, inward minors (~8 px) halfway; mirrored on the top frame line. Labels -20 ... 20 below the frame; the frame corners are -24.5 / 24.5 kOe (no tick).

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line (black, ~5 px), which carries the ticks; the vertical zero line (col 995.78) carries none. Inward majors at -80..80 every 20 emu/g, minors at the odd tens (+/-90 included); mirrored on the right frame line. The left marks at 80 and -80 merge with curves; -80 is taken from the right frame line (1153.64), 80 from the left.

paperValues.pixels: zero crossings at -9.96 and +9.75 kOe (cols ~691.3 / 1293.1 on the zero row) -> Hc 9.86 kOe
both branches inside one ~15 px (0.5 kOe) stroke at M = 0, centred at +0.04 kOe; not resolvable
curves at the right frame edge between ~74 and ~81 emu/g

pitfalls: Four-quadrant: the black zero lines (row 646.91, col 995.78) cross the box like a second pair of axes but carry no ticks; the ticks hang on the bottom/left frame lines.
The legend ("Pressure (GPa)" and seven line samples with labels 4.0 ... 0.4) sits inside the top-left quadrant and the horizontal zero line passes through it between the 1.0 and 0.8 entries.
Seven loops of similar colours overlap heavily (4.0 dark grey, 3.5 red, 2.6 blue, 1.5 green, 1.0 purple, 0.8 olive, 0.4 cyan); the loops are not single-valued in x.
Minus signs are short dashes; labels are a serif font; Y title "Magnetization (emu/g)", X title "Internal field (kOe)".
Pixel-doubled source: every row and column appears twice.
Panel letter "(a)" at the top left outside the frame.
